Airbus A320
The Airbus A320 is an aircraft that utilizes hydraulic systems to power various important aircraft systems.

Hydraulic System
A system used in the Airbus A320 aircraft to provide power to critical aircraft components, operating through hydraulic pressure.

Aircraft System
Various functions and components within an aircraft that require power for operation.

Hydraulic Power
The power generated by hydraulic systems, used for flight controls, landing gear, brakes, and other aircraft functions.

Flight Control
A system within an aircraft that manages the flight path and attitude.

Landing Gear
A component of an aircraft used for takeoff and landing.

Brake
A component used in aircraft to decelerate or stop motion.

Aircraft Function
Operations and activities performed by an aircraft.

Hydraulic Pressure
The force exerted by a fluid in a hydraulic system, enabling components to operate.
